description: Work with notes (Type > Notes, Notes panel, Note tool): add a note at a text position, list notes with author and dates, convert text to a note or a note to text, split a note, expand or collapse notes, remove notes from a story or the document, go to the next, previous, first or last note, or invoke Notes Mode at a text position

action.description: add | list | convert_text_to_note | convert_to_text | split | set_collapsed | remove | select (go to a note) | notes_mode

all.description: remove: every note in the document (Remove All Notes)

collapsed.description: Collapse (true) or expand (false) the notes in Story Editor (set_collapsed); without noteIds, every note in the story

noteIds.description: Note ids from list (convert_to_text, split, set_collapsed, remove, select)

position.description: Character position in the story (add, notes_mode); defaults to the selection's insertion point, else the end of the story

splitAt.description: Character in the note text where the second note begins (split)

start.description: First character of the text to convert (convert_text_to_note)

story.description: Which story: frameId (any text frame of the story), storyId (from get_document_stories), or selection: true (the story of the selected text or text frame)

frameId.description: Id of a text frame in the story

selection.description: Use the story of the current selection

which.description: select: the note after or before the selection, or the first or last note of the story

name: manage_notes
title: Manage Notes
